indexFields.characteristic: 回合内有爆发能力，回合外防御较弱
indexFields.biography: 字文休。汝南郡平舆县人。汉末至三国蜀汉时期重臣、名士、评论家。许靖因与从弟许邵俱以品评人物而闻名于世。后被刘翊推举为孝廉，任尚书郎。曾先后投奔孔伷[zhòu]、陈祎[yī]、许贡、王朗等人，于孙策攻王朗前与家属俱避难交州，受到交趾太守士燮[xiè]礼待。其后受益州牧刘璋邀请，相继为巴郡、广汉、蜀郡太守。于刘备包围成都时欲越墙叛逃，为刘璋所获。刘备定蜀后欲将其弃用，在法正的建议下方以其为左将军长史。

skills.name: 誉虚
skills.text: 当你于出牌阶段使用牌后，你可以摸一张牌，若如此做，当你本阶段使用下一张牌后，你不能以此法摸牌且须弃置一张牌。
skills.mapping: Actor CardUseCompleted in actual Play: optional draw commits the phase debt before its draw child; the next use has a mandatory discard and cannot draw through this skill.
notes: The next-use payment is mandatory, not an optional offer that can be declined.
The debt is scoped to the same actual Play phase; an extra Play phase starts with no prior debt.
The payment may discard an owned hand or equipment card and waits for physical movement children.

skills.name: 实荐
skills.text: 当其他角色于其回合内使用第二张牌后，你可以弃置一张牌，令其于本回合获得“誉虚”。
skills.mapping: Observer CardUseCompleted with includeResponseUses and cardActionActualTurnUseOrdinalIs value 2 for another actor who is the actual turn owner; one owned HE discard precedes grantTurnSkills with targetRef actor and expiry actualTurnEnd.
notes: Current eligibility is the second use in the actual turn, not the second use in a Play phase.
The original action use ordinal must survive nested later card uses and cold continuation.
The grant expires at the actual end of that turn, including before AfterTurnEnded children.

timingInterpretation.question: Can newly acquired Yuxu retroactively trigger from the same second card completion window?
timingInterpretation.historicalWording: 该角色在本阶段使用的第二张牌结算后，你可以弃置一张牌，令其获得“誉虚”
timingInterpretation.implementationInference: The completed second action's already frozen candidate window does not retroactively discover Yuxu. The next qualifying use completed after the grant may trigger it; normally this is the third card, but a nested third use may already have finished before the grant.
timingInterpretation.evidenceBoundary: This is a rule-timing inference supported by official completion wording, not a confirmed current official FAQ ruling.
